subject: Action required: Cascade reschedule for Cumulus POC
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@cumulus-sys.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cumulus-sys.com
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC week of Mar 15 - Event: urgent outage impact

Hi Lauren and team,

Quick but important note — we just escalated an internal network/storage outage that affected two of our primary data centers. Our on-call customer engineers who were assigned to the Redwood POC are tied up with remediation and a number of stakeholders (security & infra) are now focused on incident response. Unfortunately that means we cannot host the hands-on POC scheduled for Tue Mar 16 or any day the week of Mar 15.

We really want to proceed with Redwood, but today it looks like the earliest realistic window for our engineering team will be the week starting Mar 29 (we'll confirm by EOD Wed). Procurement team also flagged that PO approval is still pending and likely to finish late March.

Apologies for the short notice — I know this cascades across your team. Can we look at options for a short pre-check/healthcheck (SE-only) this week and then plan a full customer-facing POC for a later week? Also please keep our sandbox access extended through the end of March in case we need extra time.

Thanks,
Priya Desai
Director, Platform Engineering
Cumulus Systems

---
Attachment: incident-log-stub.txt (text)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@cumulus-sys.com>
Cc: procurement@cumulus-sys.com, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC week of Mar 15 - Event: urgent outage impact

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up and absolutely understood. First priority is that your team focuses on the outage.

We can do the SE-only pre-check this week (30–45 minutes) to validate the sandbox and connectivity, and then move the full POC to a later week. A few quick asks so we can coordinate on our side:
- Can you confirm which customer engineers absolutely must be present for the POC?
- If procurement needs any updated paperwork/MPA to accelerate PO sign-off, loop them here and we'll prioritize.
- Would you prefer the full POC week of Mar 29 or Mar 30 week (we can also do Mar 30–Apr 1 if that helps travel schedules)?

I'll loop in Vivek and Marcus to confirm SE coverage and we'll send a short mutual-action-plan update.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

---
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC week of Mar 15 - Event: urgent outage impact

Internal only — planning note and coverage options.

Lauren / Marcus — I'm tied up with two back-to-back on-site customer visits Mar 23–24 (already booked travel). Marcus, I know you have one travel day on the 24th but should be available to lead. If we move the POC to Mar 30 – Apr 1 I can support remotely (morning PT) and Marcus can lead the interactive lab. If Cumulus prefers Mar 29–31 we need to ensure we have at least one SE available for their preferred time windows (east coast vs west coast).

If Marcus is unavailable for any chunk, Monica can step in for morning coverage on the west-coast times (she's already briefed on the sandbox). We also need to request a sandbox extension (current expires Mar 20) and make sure the precheck checklist runs against the same dataset.

I'll draft a short updated MAP (mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf) and a precheck checklist. Attaching drafts for quick review.

- Vivek
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (pdf), precheck-checklist.md (text)
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC week of Mar 15 - Event: urgent outage impact

Thanks Vivek — quick update from my side. I'm traveling Mar 23–25 but can be fully available Mar 30–Apr 1. Monica is good to cover mornings on Mar 29 if we want an earlier slot.

Given procurement's comment about PO timing, I'd recommend we aim for Mar 30, 10:00 PT as a tentative POC slot (gives procurement time and keeps travel conflicts minimized). If Cumulus needs early-afternoon east-coast times we should swap sessions so we have at least one SE on the call.

I'm attaching the MAP with a highlighted timeline and owner column. If procurement confirms PO by Mar 24 we can keep the Mar 30 slot; otherwise we should push to Apr 6 to avoid last-minute cancellations.

- Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@cumulus-sys.com>, Alex Raymond <alex.r@cumulus-sys.com>
Cc: procurement@cumulus-sys.com, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, marcus.lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, monica.patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC week of Mar 15 - Action: proposed new dates and pre-check

Hi Priya / Alex / Procurement —

Thank you for the update and for working through the incident triage. Based on internal availability and Marcus's travel calendar, we propose the following plan:

1) SE-only pre-check (30 mins) — Friday Mar 26, 10:00 AM PT (verify sandbox, connectivity, and datasets)
2) Full POC — Tuesday Mar 30, 10:00 AM PT (3 hour interactive session; Marcus to lead, Vivek to support)

If that works for Cumulus, we'll:
- Send updated calendar invites to each attendee (including separate session for procurement to review pricing/terms).
- Extend sandbox access through Apr 6 to accommodate testing.
- Share an updated mutual action plan and a short precheck checklist (attached).
- Send a DocuSign link for the SOW addendum if procurement would like the paperwork accelerated.

Please reply with a quick confirmation or propose an alternate time by EOD Mon Mar 15. If procurement needs to see an updated quote before confirming dates, let us know and we'll prioritize.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf, precheck-checklist.md, sandbox-access-request.txt

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@cumulus-sys.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cumulus-sys.com, alex.r@cumulus-sys.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC week of Mar 15 - Action: proposed new dates and pre-check (CONFIRMED)

Lauren — thanks, this plan looks good and we confirm both items.

- Pre-check: Mar 26, 10:00 AM PT — Priya, Alex, and our lead EE (Samir Jain) will join for the SE-only run.
- Full POC: Mar 30, 10:00 AM PT — confirmed. Procurement: we'll target PO approval by Mar 24 and will notify you if anything slips.

Please send the updated invites and extend the sandbox to Apr 6. Also please share the MAP PDF and precheck checklist so our team can review ahead of time.

Appreciate the flexibility.
Priya
Director, Platform Engineering | Cumulus Systems

Footer: Please note this thread documents a schedule change driven by a customer-side outage and travel constraints.
